questions.text: Decision dec-go-2 ("go") has no rationale text, and the parent feature "Level 1 Process Specification" is broad ("document what must happen at each step, independent of tools/software/people/APIs/implementation"). Should this requirement scope to defining the general Level 1 node schema/template (id, name, description, input, output, next_nodes, notes) that any process can use, or should it scope to actually authoring the Level 1 documentation for the specific example marketing process in the blueprint (Identify Course -> Define Campaign -> Reach Audience -> Capture Leads -> Nurture Leads -> Measure Interest -> Offer Course -> Follow Up)?

The blueprint shows a node schema with fields like id, name, description, input, output, implementation, tools, automation, next_nodes, notes -- but Level 1 should stay independent of implementation/tools/automation. Should the Level 1 requirement only ever populate id, name, description, input, output, and next_nodes (leaving implementation/tools/automation fields for Level 2), or is there a different subset of fields that counts as "Level 1"?

Where should Level 1 node documentation live and how should it be validated (e.g. one markdown/yaml file per node under docs/, a single combined process document, or something else), and who is expected to author/maintain it going forward?
